nodes.label: Issue tracker: wyrdcraft Trello board
nodes.rationale: Issues, feature ideas, and larger project ideas live on the wyrdcraft Trello board because its lists are the source of truth for work state. Skills that publish or fetch a ticket create or open a card there unless the user says otherwise.

nodes.label: wyrdcraft Trello board
nodes.rationale: Board lists are the work-state source of truth: Reference, Phase infinity, Backlog, On Deck, Doing, For release, and Release. For release means committed but not yet in a semver release. The board name is spelled wyrdcraft.
